correctness.rationale: Use independent midpoint angle U uniform [0,2π) and chord half-angle V uniform [0,π). The circumcenter lies on chord-bisector ray n(U) at signed coordinate λ=δ/(cos V-r cos U), δ=(1-r²)/2. An arcsine law for cos V yields the exact conditional clipped-arccos quadrature. The density at D=cos V-r cos U=0 is p_r(u,0)=1/(2π²sqrt(1-r² cos²u)), bounded for fixed r<1. Integrating |D|<δ/T gives c(r)=2(1-r²)K(r)/π². Since |circumradius−S|<=1, the same coefficient holds. Uniform convergence of the conditional (U,sign D,T|D|/δ) densities yields total-variation marked limit with uniform radial reciprocal mark, and sign/π-shift symmetrization gives g_r. Differentiating (1-r²)/sqrt(1-r² sin²t) proves monotonicity; elliptic K logarithmic endpoint proves boundary localization and c(r)~(1-r²)log(1/(1-r²))/π². Tail order 1/T implies infinite means for r<1, whereas r=1 yields fixed unit circle radius 1. Simulator is corroborative, not proof.
